name: Keleya Zaara
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 servings based on 750 g lamb quantity typical for 4 adult portions in Tunisian/North African stews and common recipe scaling for similar dishes.
Total time is sum of active cooking steps (5 min browning + 15 min simmering + 5-10 min sauce reduction) rounded up to 35 min; excludes any optional prep time for chopping or measuring.
Butter is classified as a dairy source (Milk allergen true).
No wheat, barley, rye or oats listed so Gluten-free is true.
No explicit tree-nut, peanut, soy, fish, shellfish or egg ingredients; Sesame left null as it could be present in an unspecified 'vegetable oil' blend but olive oil is listed.
Parsley, saffron, onion, lemon, water and olive oil are compatible with all listed diets except where dairy or animal products conflict.
Lamb makes Vegetarian, Vegan and Pescatarian false; butter makes Dairy-free and Vegan false.
instructions:
Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Season with saffron, salt and pepper to taste; stir in all but 4 tablespoons of the onion, and pour in the water. Bring to the boil, then cover, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer until the lamb is tender, about 15 minutes.
Uncover the pan, stir in the butter and allow the sauce reduce 5 to 10 minutes to desired consistency. Season to taste with salt and pepper, then pour into a serving dish. Sprinkle with the remaining chopped onions and parsley. Garnish with lemon wedges to serve.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Standard olive oil; 1 tbs ≈ 15 ml / 13.5 g so 4 tbs = 54-60 g; used 60 g as typical rounded value for nutrition databases.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.assumptions: Raw boneless lamb shoulder or leg cut for stewing; typical values for average lamb meat used in North African recipes (includes some fat marbling).

ingredients.name: Saffron
ingredients.assumptions: Dried saffron threads; 1.5 tsp ≈ 0.75-1 g (very light spice); used 1 g as plausible small-quantity estimate for a recipe serving 4.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large onion ≈ 150 g raw chopped weight; standard yellow onion values; 'all but 4 tbs' used in cooking, remainder as garnish, but whole onion weight used for the line.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.assumptions: Water contributes zero macros; 25 ml = 25 g.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh parsley leaves and stems; given as 30 g so used directly; standard raw parsley nutrition.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbs butter ≈ 14 g; standard unsalted butter values.

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: 1 whole medium lemon (edible portion with some peel for wedges) ≈ 100 g; standard raw lemon values including minor fiber from pulp.
